definitions.explanation: A man who is considered physically attractive. A somewhat formal or literary term.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{美男子|びだんし}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: He is famous for being a handsome man.

examples.japanese: ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}てくる→出てくる：29121_detekuru⟧{美男子|びだんし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧あこがれる⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many women admire the handsome men who appear in movies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名|な}→名：03496_na⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧{美男子|びだんし}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧いえば、{光源氏|ひかるげんじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{挙|あ}げられる→挙げる：27889_ageru⟧。
examples.english: When it comes to famous handsome men in history, Hikaru Genji is often mentioned.

notes:
USAGE:
A somewhat literary or formal word. In everyday conversation, ⟦イケメン→イケメン：04761_ikemen⟧ is far more common for describing a handsome man. {美男子|びだんし} has a classical, refined nuance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {美男子|びだんし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧ (famous for being handsome)
- ⟦{美男|びなん}→美男：22873_binan⟧⟦{美女|びじょ}→美女：28612_bijo⟧ (handsome men and beautiful women)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦イケメン→イケメン：04761_ikemen⟧: handsome guy — modern, casual, much more commonly used
- ⟦{美男|びなん}→美男：22873_binan⟧: handsome man — shorter form, also somewhat literary
- ⟦ハンサム→ハンサム：00090_hansamu⟧: handsome — loanword from English, slightly dated
